title: Coconut Cake
description: A traditional coconut cake made with fresh coconut, margarine, and separated eggs, baked until golden.
steps: Sift together flour, baking powder, and salt.
Add vanilla and coconut extract to the creamed mixture.
Add dry ingredients and milk to creamed mixture in 3 separate times. Mix well after each.
Beat egg whites till stiff but not dry.
Pour into 2 9" cake pans, greased and floured, or 9x13 pan.
